description: This source file manages the lifecycle of modules within the 'lighttpd2' server. It provides functions to initialize, lookup, load, release, and cleanup modules, handling dynamic loading and error management.

classes.name: liModules
classes.description: Struct representing a collection of loaded modules, including their directory, version, and associated array of module pointers.

classes.name: liModule
classes.description: Struct representing an individual module, including its name, path, reference count, and function pointers for initialization and cleanup.

methods.name: liModules * li_modules_new(gpointer main,const gchar * module_dir,gboolean module_resident)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new liModules structure with specified main context, module directory, and residency flag.

methods.name: liModule * li_module_lookup(liModules * mods,const gchar * name)
methods.description: Searches for a module by name within the loaded modules and returns a pointer to it if found.

methods.name: void li_modules_free(liModules * mods)
methods.description: Frees all loaded modules, calling their cleanup functions, and releases associated resources.

methods.name: liModule * li_module_load(liModules * mods,const gchar * name,GError ** err)
methods.description: Loads a module by name, handling dynamic loading, symbol resolution, initialization, and insertion into the modules list.

methods.name: void li_module_release(liModules * mods,liModule * mod)
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for a module and unloads it if the count reaches zero, freeing resources.

methods.name: void li_module_release_name(liModules * mods,const gchar * name)
methods.description: Looks up a module by name and releases it if loaded.
